source_caption:
🎥🎬: Transformers: Dark of the Moon (2011)

Sam Witwicky is trying to build a normal life when he discovers that the Autobots and the U.S. government have been hiding a shocking secret about the Apollo 11 moon landing. The discovery reveals that a crashed Cybertronian spacecraft on the Moon could change the course of the war between the Autobots and Decepticons.

When the Decepticons launch a massive plan to bring their fallen leader, Sentinel Prime, back into the fight, Earth becomes the center of a devastating battle. With Chicago turned into a war zone, Optimus Prime and the Autobots must fight to save humanity from a Decepticon invasion that could reshape the planet forever.

source_details.synopsis: Transformers: Dark of the Moon is a 2011 American science fiction action film based on Hasbro's Transformers toy line. It is the sequel to Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen (2009) and the third installment in the Transformers film series. Like its predecessor, the film was directed by Michael Bay, and written by Ehren Kruger. Shia LaBeouf, Josh Duhamel, John Turturro, Tyrese Gibson, Kevin Dunn, and Julie White reprise their roles from the previous films, with Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, Patrick Dempsey, John Malkovich, and Frances McDormand joining the cast.
